task: regression: peptide half-life as log10(half-life in seconds)
model_family: sequence-embedding-based regression: ESM2-150M mean-pooled embedding plus physicochemical descriptors, modification flags and measurement context, fed to gradient-boosted trees
scope: Mammal-only variant of half_life_predictor_v1: same features and model, trained only on half-lives measured in mammals (mouse, rat, human, monkey, pig, dog, rabbit, cow, sheep, cat). Chicken, insect and unknown_or_other rows are dropped.
measurement_organisms: Mammalian organisms only, mostly mouse, rat and human (see training_data.species_counts).
architecture: mean of 5 cluster-fold XGBRegressor models (reg:squarederror, enable_categorical=True); no full-data refit
esm_embedding: mean-pooled last_hidden_state over every attended token including BOS/EOS, sequence passed as given (uppercase standard residues)
feature_order: desc_length, desc_net_charge, desc_pI, desc_hydrophobicity (modlAMP HydrophRatio), desc_hydrophobic_moment (Eisenberg), desc_aromatic_fraction, desc_cationic_fraction (K/R/H)
species, matrix, vivo_vitro (pandas category; integer codes follow the sorted level order below)
categorical_levels_note: Read back from the saved fold models. They differ from v1: v1 also has chicken, insect and unknown_or_other for species and unknown for vivo_vitro. A context value outside these lists is rejected.

training_data.sources: PEPlife and DRAMP, merged and de-duplicated on (molecule_id, PMID); all 1179 retained mammal rows come from PEPlife
training_data.residues: 20 uppercase standard amino acids only; D-form and non-standard sequences excluded
training_data.filters: censor_status == exact; named-enzyme rows dropped; matrix x vivo_vitro |z| > 3 outliers dropped; then species restricted to mammals
training_data.cv: 5 folds by CD-HIT cluster (40% identity), clustered on the mammal sequences only (124 clusters), whole clusters per fold, greedy size-balanced assignment

cv_metrics.source: pipeline_esm2_150m_mammal.ipynb, out-of-fold predictions of the saved fold models
cv_metrics.caveats: Hyperparameters were picked by a grid search scored on the same five folds that produce these out-of-fold numbers (not nested CV), so the metrics are somewhat optimistic. They are not comparable with v1's: the data subset and the fold split both differ.
